speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me your age and whether you have noticed any bone pain, specifically in your legs or hips, as this is important for your symptoms of fatigue, fever, and easy bruising.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

Given the combination of age (4 years), constitutional symptoms (fatigue, fever), signs of marrow failure (bruising), and specific bone pain (legs/hips), these findings are highly suggestive of ALL. I will proceed with requesting a complete blood count with differential and peripheral blood smear to confirm the diagnosis.
